content: {"praised":["Susan Hampshire’s acting is excellent and not wooden.","The cast is very good and engaging.","The show’s visuals and period detail are impressive.","The series has a strong, fashionable hotel setting.","The storyline follows a compelling family-run enterprise."],"criticized":["The series presents historical lies with modern attitudes.","The plot is predictable and not well written.","Characters lack likability and depth.","The tone is too evil and harsh.","It is not suitable for families."]}
